query:
SELECT unitId, 
  CASE 
    WHEN overview LIKE '%sj%' OR overview LIKE '%zj%' THEN 'overview'
    WHEN grammarExplained LIKE '%sj%' OR grammarExplained LIKE '%zj%' THEN 'grammar'
    WHEN practiceExamples LIKE '%sj%' OR practiceExamples LIKE '%zj%' THEN 'practice'
  END as section
FROM unit_explanations 
WHERE overview LIKE '%sj%' OR overview LIKE '%zj%' 
   OR grammarExplained LIKE '%sj%' OR grammarExplained LIKE '%zj%'
   OR practiceExamples LIKE '%sj%' OR practiceExamples LIKE '%zj%';
